options: A whole answer in a conversation
A single section of an answer (e.g. eligibility, documents, fees)
An item in a saved action plan
questions.reason: The decision says "an answer or a source", but answers are made of dynamic sections and also appear in action plans and public articles; the target model depends on this.
answer: A whole answer in a conversation

questions.text: Which problem types should the user choose from?
questions.reason: The decision names three types; the blueprint also mentions outdated links. The allowed list is validated by the API.

questions.text: Is a free-text description from the user required?
questions.reason: It changes validation and how useful a report is to the reviewer.

questions.text: What is the maximum length of the description (characters)?
questions.reason: Needed for validation; not stated anywhere.

questions.text: Can the user suggest the correct information or a better source (a separate field)?
questions.reason: A suggested correction is a separate field and helps the review, but it is not mentioned in the decision.

questions.text: What happens if the same user reports the same target again?
options: Reject while their earlier report is still open
questions.reason: Duplicate handling is not defined and affects the API response and storage.
questions.answer: Reject while their earlier report is still open

questions.text: What can the reporter see or do after submitting?
options: See the status of their reports
Edit or withdraw a report while it is open
Be notified when it is resolved
questions.reason: Decides whether this requirement needs more than the create endpoint.

questions.text: Should the team's review (list, filter, change status of reports) be part of this requirement?
questions.reason: The decision says "review later"; it is unclear whether the review API belongs here or to the admin features in blueprint section 11.

questions.text: Should a report keep a copy of the reported answer or source as it was at the time of reporting?
questions.reason: Answers are generated dynamically and sources change; without a copy a later reviewer may not see what the user saw. A copy can also contain personal details.

questions.text: May a user report only answers and sources that were shown to them (in their own conversations)?
questions.reason: Decides whether the API must check the target against the user's own history before accepting a report.

questions.text: What is the tenant for a report: one organisation per tenant, or one tenant for all My Guide users?
questions.reason: The API app uses row-level multi-tenancy; the tenant boundary decides who can see a report.
questions.answer: Type: one tenant per organization. An  report belongs to the tenant of the signed-in user and is never visible across tenants.

questions.text: Should there be a limit on how many reports one user can submit?
options: A per-user rate limit (e.g. per hour)
questions.reason: Abuse protection is not defined; it changes the API's behaviour (429 responses).

questions.text: How long are reports kept, and should they be deleted with the user's data when they ask for deletion?
questions.reason: Reports can contain personal details (in the description and the snapshot); the blueprint has data deletion controls but no rule for reports.
questions.answer: Type: Kept until an admin deletes them. They are also deleted when the user asks for deletion of their personal data.
